A shortlist · nine rooms of steam

Leemya

Arabic لَمْيَاء — luminous, beautiful and some saunas to match…

Nine of the strangest, wildest, most beautiful places on earth to sit in the heat, plunge into the cold, and be covered head to toe in mud — sorted by how much of your time they would actually cost. Assembled for an audience of one.

Begin

There’s a version of this that begins an hour from Cambridge — and ends, if it ever got that far, in Morocco.

You said someone ought to find the best saunas in the world. I took that more seriously than you intended. Built for the busy woman you are, they are sorted by what they would cost you in time, and I’ve staggered them by distance too. The first three are real. The last three are for dreaming. Every one was chosen for a reason, and most of those reasons are green — your colour, not mine. I did briefly consider building the whole thing in dark brown instead. I decided that was too obvious.

Entirely hypothetical, obviously.

Nothing is booked — that’s rather the point, as you’ll see.

Nine rooms. Steam behind every one.
Which would you argue for?

This isn’t a plan and it isn’t a proposal. It’s a shortlist, and shortlists are far better argued about in person than on a screen. Pick the one you’d fight for — there is something waiting behind whichever one you choose.

JACKPOT

CongratulationsYou are a winner

To claim your prize, simply answer this multiple-choice question

Can I take you out for dinner?

There is no wrong answer

Right — joking aside.

Genuinely, I would love to get to know you better, but I appreciate how busy you are — and you were probably not expecting that!

I won’t be the least bit offended if it’s a no, but I haven’t been in this situation for some time. Not on purpose — I just hadn’t bumped into someone like you, in the right place at the right time… and something was telling me that if I didn’t ask, I’d regret it.

I love food, I love cooking all sorts, and I love eating out. So tell me the best thing you’ve ever eaten in Cambridge and the one place you’ve been meaning to try. You choose when and where, and I’ll book it.

Sorry, if this is too much — I blame the ADHD… hahaha…

You’ve got my number…

P.S. I don’t make entire websites trying to get a date as standard practice. Bit of fun, as I said — and maybe more fun to be had? I hope it lands well.

— Dean

For Leemya — luminous beauty.

— Dean
